notes:
Settings are reorganised. Each setting has one home: Typography now sits with the rest of the project's settings, read-aloud voices and ambient sounds share «Voices & audio», the assistant, its models and agent access are together under «AI», and the distraction-free background sits next to distraction-free mode.

Search in Settings finds individual settings, not just pages. Type «spacing», «dark» or «voice» and pick a result to jump straight to that control.

Settings work from the keyboard: Tab through the pages, Esc to close, and focus stays inside the window while it is open. Every theme now shows the selected page clearly.

On/off settings use the same switch everywhere, the window is larger, and the Spanish page names are shorter so they fit on one line.
